{{Top|leg}}
A '''cartouche''' was a motif featured in the architecture of the ninety-ninth floor of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This level was sparsely decorated and mostly consisted of [[Color/Legends|white]] walls, with the occasional columnar cartouche and linteled doorway. [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] approved of the design, since less embellishment meant less chance of indecourousness.<ref name="Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In real-life, a cartouche is an illustration or piece of stone resembling an unrolled scroll, often with writing on it and used as a decorative element.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cartouche|text=cartouche|quote=a drawing or piece of stone that looks like a scroll (= a long roll of paper) with the ends rolled up, often with writing on it and used as a decoration|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press & Assessment|Cambridge University Press & Assessment]]|archivedate=20220503085104}}</ref>
